02 / AI & SOFTWARE ENGINEERING

AI architecture,
with concrete examples.

We design the context a model receives, the tools it can access and the steps that require human approval. Here is how these ideas appear in the portfolio:

↔

01 / CONTEXT

Context engineering

Organising the instructions, data and evidence a model needs. Prompt Operating System explores how to prepare that context and connect it to the output.

⌘

02 / RETRIEVAL

Hybrid retrieval

Combining keyword search with semantic similarity. Pharos brings BM25 and vector search together with source records, entity relationships and change tracking.

⊞

03 / APPROVAL

Human-in-the-loop

Including human approval at decision points. In Bungalow OS, an approval-gated agent, role-based access and audit logs are elements of this approach.

04 / VOYAGERROC TECHNOLOGIES

Models, tools and data.
Designed together.

Voyagerroc TechnologiesProduct & systems

What data can an AI agent access? Which tools can it use? When must it ask for approval? We approach agentic workflows through these product decisions.

We use AI-assisted development for research, code and documentation. The developer’s role includes architecture, reviewing model output, testing integrations and understanding product behaviour.

For clients, our working standard is a clear scope, defined deliverables and acceptance criteria. For developers, data access, dependencies and technical decisions should be understandable. For LLM-based work, we treat evaluation scenarios (evals) as part of project planning.
